Ava (prod): Quick OKR milestone check — please drop what shipped/slipped by your teams and owners + any CR pings. Trying to close quarter snapshot by EOD Fri. @Diego @Priya @Marta

Diego: Infra update — model-routing canary shipped to prod yesterday. Throughput tests look good (no regressions so far). Owner: Diego. No slips to report.

Priya: Runtime update — rolled back v2 canary this morning after seeing latency regressions on a subset of routes. Owner: Priya. Slip: ~1 sprint for the rollout while we root-cause.

Ken: Ken here — can take a look Mon AM. Can you attach the perf flame or a repro? Also try running with `--kv-cache=on` to see if KV cache exposure is the cause.

Priya: Perf snippet below for context:
```text
p95 before: 120ms
p95 after: 230ms
trace: nvprof attached
```
Thanks @Ken — I also put the trace file in the perf bucket.

Marta: Client SDK: shipped small fixes for retry logic this week. CR pending for the TS types update (affects web SDK). Owner: Marta.

Liam: On the SDK CR — will review today, ETA 3pm. Flagged one minor doc nit.

Ava (prod): Thanks — can folks add final statuses to the OKR spreadsheet? Link: https://docs.internal/okr/q3-milestones (view/edit). Last ask: any blockers that need cross-team help?

Diego: No blockers from infra.

Priya: Blocker: kernel perf input from @Ken and SRE logs from @deploy-bot (if safe to share).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: fetched recent deploy logs for the canary window — summary: restarts=2, p95 spikes correlated with rollout. Full logs in s3://redwood-logs/perf/canary-3133 (restricted).

Ava (prod): Ok noted. I'll create a follow-up ticket and set up a 30m sync Tues if needed. :thumbsup:
